name: Click Recorder
description: Records your own clicks as .gdr2 files and replays them in the level.

auto-record.name: Record automatically
auto-record.description: Start recording as soon as a level opens. Turn off to only record when you press Record.

auto-save.name: Save when you beat the level
auto-save.description: Save a click file automatically when you complete the level.

save-on-death.name: Save failed attempts
save-on-death.description: Also save a click file when you die.

tps.name: Ticks per second
tps.description: The physics tick rate your game runs at. Leave at 240 unless you changed it with a TPS mod.

replay-file.name: Replay file
replay-file.description: The .gdr2 click file that Play uses. You can also pick it with Open File in the pause menu.

auto-play.name: Play automatically
auto-play.description: Play the replay file as soon as a level opens.

hide-pause-button.name: Hide in pause menu
hide-pause-button.description: Remove the Clicks button from the pause menu. The keybinds still work.

show-notifications.name: Show notifications
show-notifications.description: Show a message when recording starts or pauses, a file is saved, or a replay starts.

key-save.name: Save
key-save.description: Save the clicks recorded so far.

key-play.name: Play / Stop
key-play.description: Restart the level and play the replay file, or stop the replay.
